guides.description: Prepaying a home or personal loan can save lakhs in interest. Learn how part-prepayments shorten tenure, then model your own loan with our free EMI calculator.
faq: Does prepayment always save money?
Almost always, when the prepayment goes fully toward principal. Compare the interest saved against any prepayment penalty your lender charges.
Should I reduce tenure or EMI after prepaying?
Reducing tenure usually saves more interest because the loan closes earlier. Reducing EMI helps monthly cash flow instead.
Is there a penalty for prepaying a loan?
Many floating-rate home loans have no prepayment penalty, but fixed-rate loans and personal loans often do. Check your loan agreement first.
Is my loan data stored when I use the calculator?
No. All EMI calculations happen in your browser and nothing is uploaded anywhere.
sections: How prepayment works
Every EMI has two parts: interest and principal. Early in the loan, most of your EMI pays interest. A part-prepayment goes directly against principal, so all future EMIs accrue less interest.
Tenure vs EMI reduction
After a prepayment, lenders let you keep the EMI and shorten the tenure, or keep the tenure and lower the EMI. Shortening tenure normally saves far more total interest.
Worked example

On a 20-year home loan, a single 10% prepayment in year 3 can shave off more than a year of tenure and save several EMIs worth of interest. Enter your own numbers in the EMI calculator linked below to see your exact saving.
guides.title: Loan Prepayment Guide

guides.description: Raw JSON from an API is unreadable until formatted. Learn what JSON formatting does, how validation works, and how to pretty-print any payload with our free tool.
faq: What does a JSON formatter do?
It parses raw JSON and re-prints it with indentation and line breaks, and reports syntax errors with their location when the input is invalid.
Why is my JSON not formatting?
Almost always a syntax mistake: missing comma, unquoted key, or trailing comma. The validator message shows the exact position to fix.
Is formatting the same as validating?
No. Formatting pretty-prints valid JSON; validation checks whether it is valid at all. Use the validator first, then format.
Is my JSON uploaded anywhere?
No. Formatting runs entirely in your browser using JavaScript. Your data never leaves your device.
sections: What JSON formatting means
Formatting (pretty-printing) takes compact JSON like {"a":1} and expands it with indentation so humans can read nested objects and arrays at a glance.
Format vs minify vs validate
Format for reading, minify for shipping (smaller files, faster APIs), validate for debugging. The three tools below cover each job.
Common errors and fixes
Missing commas between fields, single quotes instead of double quotes, and trailing commas are the top three causes of invalid JSON. Paste the payload into the formatter to pinpoint each one.
guides.title: How to Format JSON Online

guides.description: Minified JSON loads faster but cannot be read. Learn when to minify, when to format, and how to switch between the two with free in-browser tools.
faq: Should I store formatted or minified JSON?
Store and transmit minified JSON; keep a formatted copy for debugging. Version control diffs are also cleaner on formatted files.
Does minifying break my JSON?
No. Minifying only removes insignificant whitespace, so the data is byte-identical in meaning. Validate after minifying to be sure.
How much smaller does JSON get?
Typically 20-40% smaller depending on nesting depth and key lengths. Large API payloads benefit the most.
Is my data uploaded?
No. Both tools run locally in your browser.
sections: Why minify
Whitespace can be a third of a JSON payload. Stripping it cuts bandwidth and parse time for APIs, configs, and stored documents.
When to keep it readable
Debugging, code review, documentation, and config files humans edit should stay formatted. Minify only at build or deploy time.
The round trip
Paste minified output into the formatter any time to inspect it, then minify again before shipping. Both directions are lossless.
guides.title: JSON Minify vs Format

guides.description: Price hikes, salary raises, and growth rates are all percentage increases. Learn the formula with worked examples, then calculate any increase with our free tool.
faq: What is the percentage increase formula?
Increase = ((New - Old) / Old) x 100. For example, 50 to 75 is ((75-50)/50) x 100 = 50%.
What is the difference between increase and decrease?
Increase measures growth from a smaller old value; decrease measures a drop. Each has its own calculator linked below.
Can increase exceed 100%?
Yes. Doubling is a 100% increase; tripling is 200%. There is no upper limit.
Is the calculator free?
Yes, completely free with no sign-up, and all math happens in your browser.
sections: The formula
Subtract the old value from the new value, divide by the old value, multiply by 100. That is the entire method.
Worked examples
Salary 40,000 to 44,000: (4,000/40,000) x 100 = 10% raise. Price 200 to 150 is not an increase at all - that is a 25% decrease, covered by the companion calculator.
Common mistakes
Using the new value as the denominator, and confusing percentage points with percent. A rise from 10% to 12% is 2 percentage points but a 20% increase.
guides.title: Percentage Increase vs Decrease

guides.description: Percentages confuse everyone at first. Learn the three core percentage calculations - find X%, what-percent, and reverse - with simple examples and a free calculator.
faq: How do I find X% of a number?
Multiply the number by X and divide by 100. 15% of 200 = (200 x 15) / 100 = 30.
How do I find what percent A is of B?
Divide A by B and multiply by 100. 30 out of 50 = (30/50) x 100 = 60%.
How do I reverse a percentage?
If 30 is 15% of some number, divide: 30 / 0.15 = 200. The original number was 200.
Does the calculator show the formula?
Yes. Every result includes the formula used so you can verify the math.
sections: The three core calculations
Almost every percentage problem is one of three types: find X% of N, find what percent A is of B, or find the whole when a part and its percent are known.
Worked examples
Discount: 25% off 80 = 20 off, pay 60. Test score: 42/50 = 84%. Tip: 15% of a 1,200 bill = 180.
Percentages in daily life
GST and VAT, salary hikes, loan interest, exam scores, and battery levels are all the same three calculations wearing different clothes.
guides.title: How to Calculate Percentage

guides.description: Age in years, months and days, the exact formula, leap-year handling, and dd-mm-yyyy formats - plus a free calculator that does it instantly and privately.
faq: What is the formula to calculate age?
Subtract the birth date from today's date, borrowing months and days like ordinary subtraction. If this month's birthday has not occurred yet, subtract one year.
How to calculate age in dd mm yyyy?
Enter the date of birth in day-month-year order into the calculator above; it parses dd-mm-yyyy as well as yyyy-mm-dd formats.
Do leap years affect age calculation?
Yes, and the calculator accounts for them: someone born on Feb 29 legally ages on Feb 28 or Mar 1 in non-leap years depending on jurisdiction.
Is my birth date stored?
No. The calculation runs in your browser and your date of birth is never sent anywhere.
sections: The exact method
Age = today minus birth date, computed in years, then remaining months, then remaining days - with borrowing when the day or month goes negative.
Leap years and edge cases
Feb 29 birthdays, month-end dates (Jan 31 to Feb 28), and timezone boundaries are where naive calculators go wrong. This tool handles all three.
Beyond years
Total days lived, days until your next birthday, and the weekday you were born on are one click away in the related date tools below.
guides.title: Age From Date of Birth

guides.description: SIP returns confuse even seasoned investors. Learn how monthly SIPs compound, what XIRR means, and how to project your own SIP growth with a free calculator.
faq: What is a SIP?
A Systematic Investment Plan invests a fixed amount every month into a mutual fund. Returns compound because each installment grows for a different length of time.
What returns can I expect from a SIP?
Equity SIPs in India have historically returned roughly 10-14% annually over long periods, but returns are market-linked and never guaranteed.
SIP vs lump sum: which is better?
Lump sum wins in steadily rising markets; SIPs win on discipline and rupee-cost averaging in volatile ones. Neither is guaranteed.
Is this financial advice?
No. The calculator shows math projections only and does not constitute financial advice.
sections: How SIP math works
Each monthly installment compounds separately for its remaining duration. The future value is the sum of 12+ individually grown amounts per year.
XIRR in plain words
XIRR is the single annual rate that explains your SIP's actual growth, accounting for the timing of every installment. It is the only fair way to compare SIPs.
Worked example
10,000 per month for 10 years at 12% grows to roughly 23 lakh on 12 lakh invested. Change any input in the calculator to model your own plan.
guides.title: SIP Returns Explained

guides.description: Compound interest is why small savings become large sums. Learn the formula, compounding frequencies, and the Rule of 72 - then project growth free.
faq: What is the compound interest formula?
A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt): principal times one plus the per-period rate, raised to the number of periods.
What is the Rule of 72?
Divide 72 by the annual rate to estimate doubling time. At 8%, money doubles in about 9 years.
Monthly vs annual compounding?
More frequent compounding earns slightly more: monthly beats quarterly beats annual, all else equal.
Is this financial advice?
No. Educational projections only; consult a qualified advisor for decisions.
sections: Simple vs compound
Simple interest pays only on principal. Compound interest pays on principal plus past interest - the snowball that makes long horizons powerful.
Frequency matters
The same 8% grows faster compounded monthly than annually. Banks quote nominal rates; always compare effective annual rates.
The Rule of 72
The fastest mental estimator in finance: years to double = 72 / rate. Verify any estimate instantly with the calculator below.
guides.title: Compound Interest Basics

guides.description: Base64 turns binary into safe text for emails, URLs and APIs. Learn how encoding works, when to use it, and how to encode or decode anything free.
faq: What is Base64 encoding?
A way to represent binary data using 64 safe ASCII characters, so images or files can travel inside text formats like JSON, email, or URLs.
Is Base64 encryption?
No. It is encoding, not encryption - anyone can decode it instantly. Never use it to hide secrets or passwords.
Why is Base64 output longer?
Every 3 input bytes become 4 output characters, so encoded data is about 33% larger than the original.
Is my data uploaded?
No. Encoding and decoding happen entirely in your browser.
sections: How it works
Three bytes (24 bits) split into four 6-bit groups, each mapped to a letter, digit, + or /. Padding = signs fill the last block.
Where you meet it
Email attachments (MIME), data-URLs in CSS, JWT tokens, and API payloads carrying images are all Base64 in the wild.
Encoding is not encryption
Base64 provides zero secrecy. For passwords and tokens use real hashing (see the hash generator) and HTTPS transport.
guides.title: Base64 Encode Decode Guide

guides.description: Word counts decide grades, publishing fees and SEO limits. Learn how counting works, why tools disagree, and how to get an exact count free and privately.
faq: How does a word counter work?
It splits text on whitespace. Hyphenated words, numbers, and contractions each count per the tool's rules, which is why tools differ slightly.
Characters with or without spaces?
Both matter: social platforms usually count with spaces; SMS segments and some forms count without. This tool shows both.
Why do two counters disagree?
Different rules for hyphens, slashes, em-dashes, and numbers. For submissions, always use the recipient's own counter as final.
Is my text uploaded?
No. Counting runs locally in your browser; your text never leaves your device.
sections: Counting rules
Words = whitespace-separated tokens. Characters = every symbol including spaces (or excluding them). Sentences = segments ending in . ! ?. Reading time assumes ~200 words per minute.
Why counts differ
Is 'well-known' one word or two? Is '2026' a word? Every tool answers slightly differently; consistency within one tool matters more than the absolute number.
Hitting exact limits
Write 10% under the limit, then trim. Paste the final text into the counter for the exact number before submitting essays, applications, or meta descriptions.
guides.title: Word Count Guide
